title: Agent
kicker: Simulation · explains data · no investment advice
emptyBody: Every figure in a reply comes with its source and time. A change to your layout, rules, profile or simulated portfolio is shown as a preview first, and you can undo it.
noSource: This reply cites no data source.
working: Working on it. A reply can take up to a minute: each figure is fetched and checked.

timeline.title: Steps the agent took
timeline.unavailable: The steps are not available right now.
timeline.empty: No readable step yet. The log can lag by a few seconds.
timeline.note: Sentences written by code from the log rows, with no language model.
timeline.type: {type, select, layout_change {layout change} rule_create {new rule} rule_propose {new rule} rule_pause {rule pause} profile_change {profile change} simulated_trade {simulated trade} module_propose {new module} explain_pick {explanation of a pick} lookup {data lookup} reply {reply} other {other action}}

steps.chat_input: I received your message ({turns, plural, =0 {no earlier turn} one {# earlier turn} other {# earlier turns}})
steps.context_built: I checked your profile (risk {risk, select, Low {low} Medium {medium} High {high} other {{risk}}}, level {level, select, Novice {Novice} Intermediate {Intermediate} Expert {Expert} other {not set}}): {holdings, plural, =0 {no position} one {# position} other {# positions}}, {picks, plural, =0 {no watched pick} one {# watched pick} other {# watched picks}}
steps.context_built_noProfile: I read your data, with no risk profile: {holdings, plural, =0 {no position} one {# position} other {# positions}}, {picks, plural, =0 {no watched pick} one {# watched pick} other {# watched picks}}
steps.orchestrator_call: I called the model {model} ({input, number} input tokens, {output, number} output)
steps.guardrail_passed: Guardrail: no issue found in the figures and wording
steps.guardrail_failed: Guardrail: an issue was found on attempt {attempt}, the reply was redone
steps.action_preview: I prepared a proposal ({type}) waiting for your confirmation
steps.action_info: I prepared some information ({type}), with no change
steps.action_dropped: The proposal ({type}) was set aside by the app's validation
steps.preview_shown: I showed you a preview ({type}){conflicts, plural, =0 {} one {, with # profile conflict} other {, with # profile conflicts}}
steps.cancelled: You cancelled the preview: nothing was changed
steps.applied: The change was applied in the simulation
steps.result_error: The request did not go through
steps.result_cache: Reply taken from an earlier reply that had passed every check
steps.result_refused: The reply was replaced by a neutral sentence
steps.result_reply: I wrote the reply ({sources, plural, =0 {no source cited} one {# source cited} other {# sources cited}})
